summary: Mineralys Therapeutics filed a prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for a follow-on offering of 5,660,378 common shares at $26.50 per share, raising $150 million gross. The offering price represents a ~8.1% discount to the prior close of $28.85. BofA Securities, Goldman Sachs, and Evercore ISI are underwriters. Net proceeds to the company are $143.25 million before expenses. The deal is a standard capital raise with no special-situation trigger; it is not an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring. Shares settle on June 4, 2026. Risk-arb or event-driven angle is absent; this is routine financing.
